## Connection configuration

Secret fields should be given as a reference, `<field>_ref`, such as `env://NAME`, rather than a literal.

| Key | Secret |
|---|---|
| `host` | no |
| `port` | no |
| `database` | no |
| `user` | no |
| `password_ref` | no |
| `driver` | no |
| `password` | yes; prefer `password_ref` |
